purpose: Priority-41 State-dossier prose curation: international accountability bodies, exact ministries/offices, and jurisdiction-specific executive institutions.
identityRule: Promote only stable institutions/organizations clearly identified by surrounding dossier text. Anaphora may bind to an already named body; malformed fragments, generic forces, geographic scopes and non-enumerated governing/task-force classes are rejected or deferred.
explicitDeferrals: Guinea-Bissau `Military High Command / de facto transitional governing apparatus` remains a functional scope until exact legal membership/boundary is enumerated.
Haiti's Prime-Minister-created Security Task Force remains deferred pending an exact organizational identity/provenance boundary.
Lesotho's Commission of Inquiry remains deferred because the dossier does not preserve a sufficiently exact official title or constituting instrument.
explicitNonGoals: Do not treat international findings or judgments as automatic ECL determinations.
Do not infer that a ministry, council, court or oversight office controls any project merely because it appears in the same dossier.
Do not turn geographic or functional scope labels into Actors.
